newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dubai handles its heaviest air freight shipment.
newsitem.headline: Dubai handles its heaviest air freight shipment.

text.p: Dubai airport recently handled its heaviest single air freight shipment - a 106 tonne generator for Dubai Aluminium Co (Dubal), airport handler DNATA said in a statement.
It said the equipment for Dubai Aluminium Co (Dubal) arrived from Basle airport on June 18 on board an Air Foyle Antonov 124 aircraft.
"DNATA coordinated the offloading and transportation of the generator in an elaborate operation which took close to six hours from the aircraft's arrival," it said.
The statement said the crate containing the generator from GEC Alsthom in France had to be lifted onto a custom-built ramp to be rolled off the aircraft.
The crate was then lifted from the ramp by a 400-tonne crane before being loaded onto a six-wheel hydraulic axle truck to be transported to Dubal. - Dubai newsroom +9714-6071220
